document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
It makes no difference where you are, or how you came to be here. 
You’re sleeping, tossing and turning, twisting the sheets into taut 
ropes around your body. You dream of creatures oozing putrid 
liquids from holes scattered across their amorphous bodies. You 
see the holes open and close, and then you silently scream as you 
see a morose, hungry eye resting within each hole, and hundreds 
of mouths filled with serrated teeth. Shuddering, you wake up. 
In the brief moment of sanity left to you, you see that you were 
not dreaming and not asleep in bed! It’s all really happening! You 
are being eaten! It is undoubtedly … THE END. 
(370)
